events.context: Lists physicists (Dirac, Einstein), computer scientists (Torvalds, Stallman), philosophers (Wittgenstein, Gödel) as partial feature matches for j2r prototype, notes complete combination is rare
Section III: Explains why complete j2r prototype is rare due to survival pressures (pre-modern resource access, lack of mentors, emotional suppression), historical cases require privilege and luck
Details record bias favoring successful, documented, interesting personalities; j2r likely undercounted due to unremarkable or solitary lives
Section III continued: Modern society (20th century+) creates j2r niche via specialized jobs, paper-based evaluation, ASD understanding, mentorship; predicts increase from 19th-21st centuries
Section IV: Women j2r extremely rare due to education barriers, social pressures, mentor scarcity; examples Noether (partial match), Lovelace (socially complex)
Section V: Cultural modes produce j2r variants (Soviet: pure isolation; European noble: elegant; American: competitive; East Asian: suppressed emotion)
Section VI: Trends pre-1800: 5-10; 19th: 20-30; 20th: 100-150; 21st prediction: 300-500, due to population, education, ASD recognition
Section VII: j2r disproportionate breakthroughs (Cantor, Gödel, Dirac); high-risk with many failures due to survivor bias
Section VIII: Positions j2r as structured rational branch of solitary geniuses vs. social, precocious, late-blooming types
Section IX: 21st century: more j2r (50-100/generation), earlier support, new pressures, global distribution
Conclusion: j2r rare (20-50/generation), key for paradigms, low survival historically, like rare mutations needing modern ecology; irony of rational pursuit from fragile config
Questions '基因组合?我不太懂脑科学.' (Gene combination? I don't understand neuroscience.)
Responds with analogy: brain as custom PC (j2r: top CPU/GPU, weak netcard/cooling); details genes for intellect, ASD, attention, emotion; emphasizes polygenic combination
Sections II-IV: Specific gene effects, why combination needed (Lego analogy), probability ~1/10k-1M; environment as 'firmware'
Sections VI-VII: Normal parents via recombination; brain plasticity limits rewiring
Section VIII: fMRI findings on connectivity, activation in j2r-like brains
Section IX: j2r at extreme parameter corner in gene space; rarity statistical/evolutionary/environmental
Requests '把j2r放到新石器时代看一下.' (Put j2r in Neolithic era); interrupted mid-response
Begins Neolithic transplant: initial survival crisis (useless skills, social misreads), analysis paralysis
Clarifies: '就是说他的大脑结构在一个新石器晚期的婴儿上可能出现吗?' (Could j2r brain structure appear in a late Neolithic infant?)
Section I: Affirms gene possibility low but feasible in Neolithic gene pool
